name: iktisad
displayName: iktisad: Frugal AI Agent MCP Server
description: Zero-waste terminal log compressor and AST code skeletonizer cutting up to 92% of token waste in AI coding agents.

tools.name: compress_terminal_log
tools.description: Compress noisy terminal, pytest, or compiler stdout/stderr by 80-97%. Strips ANSI codes, progress bars, and passing tests while strictly isolating root-cause tracebacks and assertion errors.

tools.name: extract_ast_skeleton
tools.description: Extract class and function signatures, line ranges, and docstrings from Python source code at 0 LLM tokens.

tools.name: select_frugal_model
tools.description: Dynamically routes tasks based on Bezos Type-1 (irreversible) vs Type-2 (reversible) doors using the Sandwich Protocol.

tools.name: check_circuit_breaker
tools.description: Inspects token burn and trips a safety circuit breaker before budget overruns occur.
